purpose: Show a real, short product interaction using an authorized screenshot sequence or screen recording.
whenToUse: A real product surface demonstrates the value
The action can be shown without exposing private data
whenNotToUse: Only a mock interface is available
The source contains credentials, personal data, or access-controlled content

layoutContract.framing: Use a window or device frame only when it improves comprehension.
layoutContract.readability: Crop to the task and preserve native pixel detail.

motionContract.entrance: Settle the UI before adding cursor, highlight, crop, pan, or zoom cues.
motionContract.determinism: Use fixed interaction points and finite timelines; never simulate unsourced UI state.
motionContract.media: Screen video stays muted and playsinline; audio is handled on its own track.

transitionOptions.use: Follow the direction of the demonstrated action.
Move from the product result to a benefit statement.

captionRules.copy: Explain why the action matters instead of transcribing visible interface labels.
captionRules.placement: Reserve a caption lane that never covers the cursor path or result.

fallbacks.action: Use an authorized screenshot with a bounded pan, crop, and highlight sequence.
Split the action across focused crops or replace it with a verified brand card.

qaRules: The action and result are visible without invented UI
No private or secret data is exposed
Text and controls remain readable at 1920x1080
